usedFor: Lofty holds your leads and Google Contacts stores the people, so “New Lead Created” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Lofty, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Every lead from the chosen list lands in Google Contacts, and “Add Contact to Group” can sort them.

watchOut: “Updated Lead” fires on edits, so pairing it with “Create Contact” can add the same lead twice.
